_meta.title: pfSense (REST API)
_meta.setup: Install the package “pfSense-pkg-RESTAPI” (pfrest.org), System → REST API → Keys: create an API key for a user with as few privileges as possible.

description: pfSense – firewall rules, interfaces, DHCP, status (pfrest v2)
notes: Firewall changes only when explicitly asked – a misconfiguration can lock you out.
